Where we work

From the Netherlands to Saudi Arabia and the GCC

Based in the Netherlands, NexoIQ supports businesses across the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, and the GCC through flexible remote consulting and project-based engagements.

NexoIQ is registered in the Netherlands. Clients outside the Netherlands are served remotely; NexoIQ has no office or legal entity in Saudi Arabia or other GCC countries.

  • Remote consulting

    Workshops, development and reviews delivered online, across time zones.

  • Project-based delivery

    Defined scope, clear deliverables and agreed acceptance criteria.

  • Monthly consulting engagements

    Ongoing support or a fixed number of consulting days per month.

  • Arabic and English communication

    Workshops, documentation and training in Arabic, English or Dutch.

  • Flexible collaboration

    Alongside your internal team, your Odoo partner or your IT provider.
